svg.title: LANL cyber1 - a regular data flow
svg.desc: Sequence of one everyday user activity (opening a file share) and the records it leaves in auth, proc, dns and flows. Values are illustrative but follow the data set format.
svg.text: t = seconds since start of the data set (real dates hidden)
THE SAME ACTIVITY AS A GRAPH
the user works from their own workstation
tickets come from a domain controller first
DNS lookup → flow → logon happen in the expected order, seconds apart
a small, stable set of servers, repeated day after day
all four sources tell one consistent story about the same IDs
